name: imagination-octo
description: One creative workflow for generating distinct ideas, waiting for the user's choice, and pressure-testing the selected direction.

interface.longDescription: A staged creative workflow that first returns a portfolio of useful, non-obvious directions, pauses for the user's choice, then pressure-tests and develops the selected idea. It preserves the independently evaluated Imagination Engine and Concept Workshop while preventing unreliable automatic selection.
defaultPrompt: Use $imagination-octo to create several directions for my brief.
Use $imagination-octo to develop the direction I selected.
Use $imagination-octo to replace these rejected ideas with new mechanisms.
